name: Emma Nakamura
source:
Your childhood friend Emma... Really your only friend from your childhood. Most of your childhood was spent beating on anyone who made her cry, which wasn't hard to do... If asked why [url=https://vndb.org/c148150]you[/url] went to such lengths for her you probably couldn't answer, but the two of you have been through everything together. Despite this, when you were at your darkest, she didn't know how to help you, leaving your relationship before now in a harsh place and both of you holding regrets for how things were left...
